verdict.rationale: Ghostty offers rich config options, keybindings, and multi-window/tab/split support, plus a macOS-only AppleScript dictionary for 'scripting windows, tabs, terminals, layouts' which could approximate scripted startup layouts, but there is no documented session/layout file format or CLI flag to launch a predefined multi-window/tab/split workspace in one command (and probe evidence shows no external IPC/remote-control interface). missing for 10: cross-platform session/layout config file, documented 'launch project workspace' example, evidence of one-command startup replicating saved layouts, and confirmation the AppleScript route actually achieves this in practice.
